description: 鹿児島県洪水浸水想定区域図(計画規模) [flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 鹿児島県. 鹿児島県管理河川の洪水浸水想定区域図（計画規模）のデータです。. Coverage: 鹿児島県. The portal files it under the publisher 鹿児島県. Its tags are 河川, 洪水, 浸水. It offers 9 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2023-11-27 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
